links.targetTitle: BD planning — industry and companion-software selection (20 Aug 2026)

title: The revenue path is a repeatable five-step sequence, not a bespoke campaign per industry
content:
The sequence recorded is: identify the companion software; build a demo with Powerhouse integration; produce social media and marketing materials from it (a YouTube recording of the demo, blog and LinkedIn posts, tweet threads, mini-sites and landing pages for SEO and agent traffic); run a conversion funnel to introduction calls; and actively target consultancy companies using that software.

The design point is that the demo is the raw material for everything downstream — the recording, the posts, the landing pages and the sales conversation are all derivatives of one artefact. That makes demo quality the leverage point of the whole motion.

Because the sequence is keyed to a piece of software rather than to an industry, it can be re-run per companion tool, which is what makes it a repeatable machine rather than a campaign.
description: Identify the companion software, build a demo integration, produce marketing from the demo, run a conversion funnel, and target the consultancies already using that software.
